description: This file defines an API class EducationAPI for managing education records within an HRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting education entries, utilizing various services and models. The class also contains API documentation annotations for OpenAPI specification.

classes.name: EducationAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for Education entities, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion, with associated validation rules and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Education record by its ID.

methods.name: getEducationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EducationService instance used by this API.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' method, ensuring the ID parameter is positive.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Education records, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing Education records, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Education record with provided data.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Saves an Education entity, setting its name from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating an Education record, primarily validating the 'name' field.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Education record identified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an Education record, including uniqueness validation.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for the 'name' property, including string type, length, and uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes Education records based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation, ensuring IDs are provided as an array of integers.
